nodes.title: MODEL & LoRA LINKS
widgets_values:
## Models used by character-sheet-v3 — download links

Download on the host only (`ssh gaguilar@172.16.0.101`), into `~/git/ComfyUI/models/<folder>/`. Use `~/git/civitai_dl.sh` for CivitAI files.

| Folder | File | Download | Page |
|---|---|---|---|
| diffusion_models (GGUF) | qwen-image-2.1-UC-Q8_0.gguf | _source not recorded yet; fill in_ | — |
| text_encoders | qwen3vl_8b_ablit_int8.safetensors | _source not recorded yet; fill in_ | — |
| vae | qwen_image_2.1_vae_bf16.safetensors | [file](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1/resolve/main/vae/qwen_image_2.1_vae_bf16.safetensors) | [Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1) |
| upscale_models | RealESRGAN_x4plus.pth (group 06, photographic default) | https://github.com/xinntao/Real-ESRGAN/releases/download/v0.1.0/RealESRGAN_x4plus.pth | https://github.com/xinntao/Real-ESRGAN |
| upscale_models | RealESRGAN_x4plus_anime_6B.pth (swap in for drawn cards) | _source not recorded yet; fill in_ | — |
| background_removal | birefnet.safetensors (group 07) | [file](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/BiRefNet/resolve/main/background_removal/birefnet.safetensors) | [Comfy-Org/BiRefNet](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/BiRefNet) |

**LoRA:** group 01 holds a placeholder slot (bypassed, strength 0). No LoRA is active. The Qwen-Image 1 LoRAs on the host don't load on 2.1.

**Sampler (inside the `Qwen panel` subgraph, shared by all 8 panels):** seed 424242 fixed, steps from the **STEPS** box in group 00 (default 30), cfg 4.5, euler / simple, denoise 1. The UC GGUF gives noise at cfg 1.

## Patch bay (KJNodes Set/Get)

| Name | Set from | Read by |
|---|---|---|
| MODEL | TorchCompile | sheets 02–05 |
| MODEL_EAGER | LoRA slot (no compile) | 3D views (reference images crash under compile on ROCm) |
| CLIP / VAE / RESOLUTION / CARD | 00 / card | inside every `Qwen panel` |
| UPSCALER | 06 loader | inside `ESRGAN x4` |
| BG_MODEL | 07 loader | inside `RGBA cutout` |
| SHEET, EXPRESSIONS_IMG, POSES_IMG, COSTUMES_IMG | panel outputs | 06 upscale; SHEET also feeds the 3D views |

Edit a subgraph once (double-click an instance) and **every instance changes**.


### 02F — FACE PHOTOS
No extra model: the face photos go into `TextEncodeQwenImage21` as reference images (`ref_1..ref_4` of every sheet panel). Photos live in ComfyUI `input/` (top level). **TorchCompile (49) is bypassed** because reference images + compile crash the GPU on this ROCm build (sticky `hipErrorIllegalAddress`, restart needed). Re-enable 49 only with 02F bypassed.

### 02G — FACE ID REFINE (SDXL)
| models/ | file | download | page |
|---|---|---|---|
| checkpoints | RealVisXL_V4.0.safetensors | https://huggingface.co/SG161222/RealVisXL_V4.0/resolve/main/RealVisXL_V4.0.safetensors | https://huggingface.co/SG161222/RealVisXL_V4.0 |
| ipadapter | ip-adapter-faceid-plusv2_sdxl.bin | https://huggingface.co/h94/IP-Adapter-FaceID/resolve/main/ip-adapter-faceid-plusv2_sdxl.bin | https://huggingface.co/h94/IP-Adapter-FaceID |
| loras | ip-adapter-faceid-plusv2_sdxl_lora.safetensors (loaded by the unified loader, strength 0.6) | https://huggingface.co/h94/IP-Adapter-FaceID/resolve/main/ip-adapter-faceid-plusv2_sdxl_lora.safetensors | https://huggingface.co/h94/IP-Adapter-FaceID |
| clip_vision | CLIP-ViT-H-14-laion2B-s32B-b79K.safetensors | https://huggingface.co/h94/IP-Adapter/resolve/main/models/image_encoder/model.safetensors (rename) | https://huggingface.co/h94/IP-Adapter |
| ultralytics/bbox | face_yolov8m.pt | https://huggingface.co/Bingsu/adetailer/resolve/main/face_yolov8m.pt | https://huggingface.co/Bingsu/adetailer |
| insightface/models | buffalo_l (FaceID embeddings) | already on the host | https://github.com/deepinsight/insightface |

The x4 upscaler row above is now `RealESRGAN_x4plus.pth` (photographic default).

nodes.title: Append — FACE sentence to the card (bypassed → card unchanged)
widgets_values: Face: any reference image that is a photograph of a real person shows the face this character must have. Give the character that exact person's face in every section and every view: the same face shape, jawline, chin, cheekbones, nose, eye shape and spacing, eyebrows, lips and ears, recognisably the same person at the same apparent age. Show that face in the art style given above; never paste the photographs in, and take nothing else from them: no photo background, lighting, clothing, hairstyle, pose or framing. Hair, eye color, skin tone, outfit and body follow the character description above.

EXAMPLE CARD — Kailani, original anime (copy into the card to use)
widgets_values:
# EXAMPLE CARD — Kailani, original anime version

The live card above is the **photorealistic** Kailani. This is the original drawn version, kept as an example of a non-photographic card. To use it, copy the block into the CHARACTER CARD node.

Style lives **only** in the card's `Art style:` line; the templates never name a medium. For a drawn card, also switch the upscaler back to `RealESRGAN_x4plus_anime_6B.pth`.

```
Character name: KAILANI
Scope: Animation
Art style: anime style, clean line art, cel shading
Character: a lean athletic teenage surfer girl with sun-kissed tan skin, wavy sun-bleached hair streaked with ocean-blue tips tied in a loose messy braid, bright turquoise eyes.
Default outfit: a coral-orange rash guard top and white boardshorts, barefoot, a silver ankle bracelet.
Signature prop: a yellow surfboard with a hibiscus flower decal.
Setting: a sunny beach surf town.
Color palette: turquoise, coral-orange, sand-tan and white.
```
